title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming parity across Python/TS/Go, ergonomics and v1.115.0 bumps
author: Asha Kapoor
description:
Context: we're shipping a multi-repo/monorepo alignment of SDK behaviour for authentication, retry semantics, and streaming ergonomics to reduce fragmentation between Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs and to unblock a coordinated version bump to v1.115.0. Motivation: several production teams observed subtle parity gaps (different default retry backoffs, inconsistent streaming backpressure APIs, and auth header refresh behaviour) that caused operational surprises when switching models or routing between hosted/dedicated/private deployments. This PR bundles fixes and ergonomics changes across all three official SDKs.

What this change does:
- Unifies auth token refresh behaviour: central auth middleware with unified cache + refresh-on-401 semantics across Python/TS/Go.
- Standardizes retry policy: converged default policy (idempotent detection, jittered exponential backoff with max attempts=5) and exposed helper to configure per-route policies.
- Streaming API parity: introduce a shared stream iterator pattern and consistent cancellation semantics; add explicit backpressure knobs for TypeScript and Go parity with Python's async generator.
- Ergonomics: convenience constructors, improved error types with canonical structured error codes, and small API rename to improve discoverability (Client.start_stream -> Client.stream).
- Version bumps: python/sdk v1.115.0, typescript/sdk v1.115.0, go/sdk v1.115.0.

Checklist:
- [x] Unit tests added for unified retry middleware (python/ts/go)
- [x] Integration test for token refresh flow against local auth mock
- [x] Streaming e2e test validating cancellation/backpressure (flaky in CI initially; rerun stable)
- [x] Changelog and upgrade notes updated

Notes: this is a coordinated change; each SDK exposes one new minor API but retains backward-compatible overloads. Breaking changes: none expected for supported call patterns; rename is additive via aliasing for one release.

Related: Linear ENG-3421 (sdk parity), ENG-3560 (streaming stability). See inline comments for platform compatibility notes.

- SDKs: v1.115.0 release
- Unified auth token refresh middleware across Python/TS/Go
